name: live
description: Opt-in real-provider flow: a text turn and a Read tool turn against the Anthropic-compatible endpoint configured by ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.

cases.description: A real model answers a text-only turn.
cases.prompt: Reply with exactly the token live-eval-ok and nothing else.

cases.description: A real model calls Read on a fixture file the case creates.
cases.prompt: Use the Read tool to read the file live-eval.txt in the current working directory. Then reply with exactly the contents of that file and nothing else.
